mapper.sql: o.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND o.order_time >= #{begin} AND o.order_time < #{end} AND o.store_id = #{storeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "orders", COALESCE(SUM(o.total_base), 0) AS "sales", COALESCE(SUM(o.profit), 0) AS "profit" FROM ecom_order o WHERE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.qty), 0) FROM ecom_order_item oi JOIN ecom_order o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) FROM ecom_order o WHERE
SELECT HOUR(o.order_time) AS "hr", COUNT(*) AS "orders", COALESCE(SUM(o.total_base), 0) AS "sales" FROM ecom_order o WHERE GROUP BY HOUR(o.order_time)
